display_long_description:
F1 Race Flow puts you in the cockpit of an open-wheel race car. Reach out, grab the wheel with both hands and turn it to steer. The right trigger is your throttle, the left trigger brakes, and the wheel vibrates in your hands when the tyres start to slide.

RACE
• Line up on a 10-car grid, watch the five red lights and launch when they go out
• Battle nine AI rivals with live position, lap and delta timing
• Fire the ERS boost on the straights and chase your personal best lap on every track
• Take the chequered flag, then cool down while the classification comes in

TRACKS AND CARS
• Six circuits through forest, autumn, winter, snowfall and heavy rain
• Two eras: modern hybrid-era cars and 1960s legends
• Earn coins with podium finishes to unlock new tracks and cars

BUILT FOR VR
• Live steering-wheel display, shift lights and a holographic HUD in the cockpit
• Corner arrows and on-track hints that help new drivers find their way
• Steering assist, wheel ratio and vibration settings
• Easy or Simulation difficulty
• Seated play with one-button recentering
• English, Turkish, German, Spanish and French
